title: AutoArmorMod
description: This mod adds automatic equipping of the best armor from the inventory, prioritizes the Protection enchantment, automatically replaces broken armor, and is controlled via the /zauto command, with support for versions 1.21.4 and 1.21.8.
body:
AutoArmor Mod is a client-side mod for Minecraft that automatically equips the player with the best armor from their inventory, simplifying gameplay and protecting the character from damage.
The mod selects armor with a priority for the **Protection** enchantment, automatically replaces broken or worn-out armor, and is fully controlled through the `/zauto` command.

Features of the mod:

* Automatic equipping of the best armor from the inventory.
* Priority for the **Protection** enchantment (Protection, Fire Protection, Blast Protection).
* Automatic replacement of broken or worn-out armor.
* Support for Minecraft versions **1.21.4** and **1.21.8**.
* Fully client-side, multiplayer compatible.

The mod makes the game more convenient, reduces the routine of armor replacement, and helps the player focus on exploring the world, combat, and building.
